content_sections.heading: MPSC Group C Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The Commission initially advertised 2,619 vacancies, which were subsequently increased through official corrigenda. The latest notification confirms that the recruitment process will cover 16,717 vacancies across 27 post categories in different government departments. Note: The revised notification includes department-wise posts such as Senior Clerk, Sub-Registrar, Assistant Superintendent, Assistant Agriculture Officer, Livestock Supervisor, Instructor and other technical and administrative positions. Candidates should refer to the official vacancy annexure for the complete post-wise and category-wise distribution.

content_sections.heading: MPSC Group C Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the MPSC Group C Combined Preliminary Examination must satisfy the educational qualifications and other eligibility requirements prescribed for their selected posts. Since the recruitment covers several departments, the required qualifications are not identical for every vacancy. The official examination scheme corrigendum provides post-specific educational requirements. Depending on the position, candidates may require a recognized degree, diploma, technical qualification, professional certificate or other prescribed qualification. Industry Inspector: Relevant engineering qualifications in the prescribed disciplines. Technical Assistant: A recognized degree or equivalent qualification as specified in the notification. Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector: Prescribed technical qualifications in Mechanical or Automobile Engineering or accepted equivalent disciplines, along with applicable experience and driving licence requirements. Clerk-Typist: A recognized degree or equivalent qualification, subject to the prescribed typing and other eligibility conditions. Relevant qualifications in Agriculture or allied disciplines as specified for the respective position. Other Group C Posts: Educational qualifications vary according to the department and nature of the position. Important: Candidates should verify the exact educational qualification, technical requirements, experience, typing proficiency and other conditions in the official post-wise eligibility annexure before choosing their preferred posts. The age requirements for MPSC Group C Recruitment 2026 depend on the post and the applicable recruitment rules. Candidates must satisfy the minimum and maximum age limits prescribed for their selected positions. Age relaxation, wherever applicable, will be governed by the relevant Maharashtra Government rules and provisions stated in the official notification. Applicants should check the prescribed age-calculation date and category-specific concessions before submitting their applications.

content_sections.heading: MPSC Group C Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The examination fee must be paid according to the category and payment instructions specified by MPSC. Candidates should check the fee applicable to them on the official application portal before completing the payment process. The corrigendum specifies that online payment can be made using debit cards, credit cards, net banking or UPI. Candidates must complete the required fee payment by 30 November 2026 .

content_sections.heading: MPSC Group C Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for MPSC Group C posts will be conducted according to the examination scheme and recruitment rules prescribed by the Maharashtra Public Service Commission. The preliminary examination will serve as the initial stage for the relevant positions. Combined Preliminary Examination: Candidates will appear in the preliminary examination conducted by MPSC. Main Examination: Candidates who qualify under the applicable criteria will proceed to the main examination or the prescribed subsequent selection stage. Post-Specific Requirements: Typing tests, skill assessments, professional requirements or other qualifying conditions may apply to certain posts. Document Verification: Candidates must produce the required certificates and supporting documents in accordance with the recruitment instructions. The Commission has also clarified that certain posts requiring specific educational qualifications may have separate main examinations. Therefore, applicants should follow the examination scheme relevant to their selected posts.

content_sections.heading: MPSC Group C Revised Prelims Exam Date 2026
content_sections.text: The Maharashtra Public Service Commission has officially revised the preliminary examination schedule for the MPSC Group C Combined Preliminary Examination 2026. As per the corrigendum dated 6 November 2026, the examination previously scheduled for 3 January 2027 has been rescheduled to 24 January 2027 . This revised examination date applies to the Group C Combined Preliminary Examination covered by the notification. Candidates should prepare according to the updated date and regularly check the MPSC website for further announcements concerning examination centres, admit cards and instructions.

content_sections.heading: MPSC Group C Recruitment 2026 Important Notification Changes
content_sections.text: The latest official corrigenda contain several significant changes affecting vacancies, applications, post preferences and the examination process. Candidates who previously applied, as well as those planning to apply during the revised application window, should review these changes carefully. Revised Vacancies: The recruitment now covers 16,717 posts across different departments. New Application Window: Eligible candidates can submit applications from 13 November to 27 November 2026. Additional Post Options: Previously registered candidates who are eligible for additional posts may submit the relevant preferences through their existing accounts. No Repeat Fee for Certain Existing Applicants: Candidates who previously applied and only submit additional eligible post preferences are not required to pay the preliminary examination fee again, as specified in the corrigendum. Original Applications Retained: Previously submitted application details remain applicable under the revised instructions. Revised Exam Date: The preliminary examination will now take place on 24 January 2027. Separate Main Examinations: Certain posts requiring special educational qualifications may have separate main examinations. Examination Scheme: MPSC has issued corrections relating to the examination scheme and post-specific eligibility provisions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for MPSC Group C Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply for the MPSC Group C Combined Preliminary Examination 2026 through the Commission's official online application portal. New applicants and candidates who previously submitted applications must follow the appropriate procedure. Visit the official MPSC online portal at mpsconline.gov.in . Log in to your existing account or complete the required registration process. Open the application section for MPSC Group C Combined Preliminary Examination 2026. Check your eligibility for the available posts. Enter or verify the required personal, educational and other application details. Select the applicable posts and preferences according to your eligibility. Upload the required documents according to the instructions on the portal. Review the application and post preferences carefully. Submit the application through the prescribed online process. Pay the applicable examination fee, if required, before the deadline. Save the final application confirmation for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under MPSC Group C Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: According to the revised notification, MPSC Group C Recruitment 2026 covers a total of 16,717 vacancies across various departments and posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the revised MPSC Group C Prelims Exam Date 2026?
faq.answer: The revised preliminary examination date is 24 January 2027. The examination was previously scheduled for 3 January 2027.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MPSC Group C Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 27 November 2026. Online examination fee payment can be completed until 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for MPSC Group C posts?
faq.answer: Educational qualifications vary by post. Depending on the position, applicants may need a recognized degree, diploma, engineering qualification, professional certificate or other specified credentials.

faq.question: Q5. Can candidates who applied earlier select additional posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Previously registered candidates who meet the eligibility requirements for additional posts can select those posts through the prescribed online process. The corrigendum also provides fee-related instructions for such candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Where can candidates apply for MPSC Group C Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply through the official MPSC online application portal at mpsconline.gov.in during the prescribed application period.
